notes.title: Need Your Advice
notes.content:
Hey guys,

I know the community is tiny and most of you may not even care, but I've got a very important question for you.

When we took the game down we din't wipe the old scores. This is a big oversight on our side, because the scoring system has been changed a little bit and ideally we should've wiped it all before re-releasing the game. But there was so much stuff on our hands that we, honestly, forgot about it. 

There are two possible solutions, but both aren't ideal. The first is to wipe all the leaderboards. Easy to do, but not very fair to those who have got medals and are at the top right now. Besides the number of players is so small that the leaderboards may stay empty. 

The second one is to delete the abnormally (old scores) high scores that hold the number one position at several leaderboards. There is only a handful of those and can be easily deleted, but again it's not very fair to the players who had got those scores in the older versions. 

I understand that in either case some of you may be upset. So, we'd like to know your thoughts on the matter and maybe you have better suggestions.

notes.title: IT'S OUT!
notes.content:
Hey!

Mist Hunter is finally out! Thank you all for your support and patience. We hope that you'll like this little game as much as we do.
Have fun and a great weekend,

Alex and Anton

notes.title: New Release! 14th February
notes.content:
First of all, we'd like to thank everyone for your support. It's been a rough time, and to be honest is still is, but your support helped us stay positive and focus on the work. 

So, in the last two months we've made a lot of changes to the game. Firstly, there is only one mode left - the summoning. The game had been started with this mode and we felt that the core fun laid in these quick, frantic battles. That's why we concentrated our effort on it. 

The mode was slightly re-imagined thematically, but in its core remained the same. We've added two more enemies to fill the empty niches, created 6 new arenas, made a quick tutorial that should help you get into the game's flow much easier. The waves and enemies were re-balanced. A ton of under the hood changes and optimization. We're also working on the post for the SW

Now to the main topic of this update. The new release date has been set on the 14th of February. Also to reflect all the changes and the missing mode we decided to price the game at 5.99$. 

If you bought the game before and haven't requested a refund yet please, please, please do so before the 14th. 
We do hope you'll like what we've made. And even though it's a much smaller game now, we believe it's gotten better. 

Cheers,
Alex and Anton

notes.title: REFUNDS!
notes.content:
We’ve been told by Valve that everyone who bought the game prior its removal is eligible to request a refund through the normal steam refund procedure, regardless of the play time. 
  
We strongly encourage you to request a refund, as you won’t be able to play the game even if you decide to keep it. This is because the game will change its internal status to “unreleased”. 
  
If you want to help with future testing or just want to through your ideas at us you can join our discord. 
 
 
We also would like to thank you for your support and understanding. It does mean a great deal to us. 


Cheers,

Alex and Anton

notes.title: This is the End
notes.content:
As you may have noticed the game is no longer available to buy.

Not the best way to end the year. And to be honest, our current mood is far below the ground zero, but we've made a tough decision to stop selling Mist Hunter and refund all the purchases. 

The reason why we did it is simple the Nexus mode isn't fun in its current state.  It has some design issues that will take significant time to address. Some of those issues may not be solvable at all without redesigning the whole thing from the ground up, which will take a significant amount of time. 

We will take a short break and focus on the mode that the game has begun with - the Summoning. It will be a much smaller game but we'll do our best to make it as fun and as polished as we can. 

We've requested Valve to issue refunds to everyone who bought the game. We don't know yet whether it's going to be automatically refunded or you might have to do it manually, but we will make a separate post about it. 

Thank you all  for playing Mist Hunter and your invaluable feedback you've given to us. 
We're really sorry for letting you down. 

Have a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year. 

Alex and Anton

notes.title: Rebalancing Patch
notes.content:
For the last few days we've gotten a fare amount of feedback and we decided to focus on re-balancing the game, in order to make it more accessible and less frustrating. 

There is a ton of small under-the-hood changes:

- the enemies have longer pauses between states,
- the number of enemies on the normal difficulty was slightly reduced and became more consistent throughout the levels
- the number of prisms that you can find was significantly increased. 
- certain enemy types became less aggressive. 
- many more tiny tweaks

If you still find yourself struggling with the pace we added an aim assist feature that can be activated in the settings. 

Cheers,

Flox Team

notes.title: It's OUT!
notes.content:
[b]It happened, the game is finally out! Hope you'll enjoy it as much as we are. [/b]

However, for us it's only the beginning. We look forward to your feedback and ideas. It's absolutely fine if you didn't like something in the game. Just let us know and we will try to improve it.

Have a great time,

Flox team

notes.title: 1 Day LEFT
notes.content:
[b]The release is tomorrow (5th December)  is 13.00 p.m. EST. [/b]

It's less than a day left before Mist Hunters will be released and we are extremely excited about it!

As the first pieces of feedback begin to trickle in we are trying to adapt it and improve as many things as we can. 
A new patch will go live in a couple of hours and it has a few big changes. 

[b]First of all[/b], the normal difficulty has become easier. We re-balanced enemies health pools and their damage. The game will be less punishing for the new players.  If you wan't more challenge jump to the Hard, but we strongly recommend starting with the normal difficulty. 

[b]Secondly[/b], we added visual and audio effects when Mist Hunter takes damage. It should improve the feedback from being attacked, as it wasn't always clear before and led to sudden death. 

We also [b]added effects[/b] to the death state to smooth out the transition between the game and the death screen. 

A window with a few[b] handy tips[/b] was added at the begging of the Nexus.  This is not an ideal solution, but should help to understand several key mechanics about the game, while we're making a proper tutorial.

[b]Memory prisms[/b] drop chance ans quantity have been re-balanced too. You should be seeing them more often and in bigger quantities.  
We also updated the demo, so if you haven't check it out it the best time to do it. 


[b]Don't forget to wishlist the game and subscribe to the group or our [url=https://discord.gg/RFnEhAk]discord[/url]. 
And please DO share your feedback and thoughts with us. It helps us tremendously.[/b]

Thank you,
Flox team

We had to change the scoring system, multipliers and reduce the number of points each enemy can give significantly. Unfortunately, to make sure that the new system is working properly we will have to reset the leaderboards. 

One of the reasons we had to make such a drastic change is that one of the players has almost reached the maximum number that the table can hold. The other one is a miscalculation in the way some of the multipliers used to work, sometimes the points could be multiplied several times. It's all been fixed and should work properly.

notes.title: Super, Mega, Huge Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UCSGnjl.png[/img]

[h1][b]The new demo is available to download and it has lots of changes. You should really try it![/b][/h1]

First of all, the primary mode that we've been working on all this time is now in the demo and it's called Nexus. It contains the first three levels and should give a pretty good idea of what the core experience is going to be like.

Each mode has several difficulty levels from the get go. If you think the game is too easy, just crank the difficulty up before you start the run. Also, don't forget to check the settings, we've added a bunch of new stuff you can tweak. 

The Nexus mode has elite type of enemies, as for now, they are just slightly tougher than their normal versions, but they'll get additional set of traits and attacks on release. 

Both modes have received a dozen of new trophies and three new power ups. Unlike in the Summoning mode, in Nexus each power up must be activated manually by pressing the "F" key. If you already carry a power up, but found another one you can swap them by pressing "E". 

Pleas bare in mind that some pieces of the game are still a WIP. You may found bugs, placeholders, or missing assets (like sounds). 


We look forward to your feedback, and if you like the demo please consider wishlisting Mist Hunter.

Have a great Friday,

Flox team

In this update we've fixed the Xbox controllers, so you should be able to play with a PS4 or Xbox controller without any issues. 

The most noticeable change is the soundtrack. We've been playing around with a fancy thing called - dynamic soundtrack. To put it simply the music changes based on the number of enemies to highlight the intensity of the fight.

We also added a visual indicator for the primary fire mode to show when a weapon is ready to fire. You can adjust the frequency in the settings or turn it off completely if you don't like it.

notes.title: Demo Updated (ver.0.05a Build 1232)
notes.content:
Hey all, 

There are not many changes in this update, but they're very important as they change the flow of the game. 

The first and the most important is the re-balance of base and bonus damage. Basically all enemies in the game have a more prominent weakness to certain type of the Mist ( ammo) you use against them. Many of them can be killed in one shot if use the right Mist. At the same time the base damage was nerfed, making some of the weapons less useful in some situations.  

Ammo drops are more frequent now and are tied to the type of weapon and the Mist it uses. It doesn't mean much in the context of the demo as it has only 4 weapons. But later, as the number of shooty things grows it will give more freedom in the loadouts. For example you'll be able to equip two or more similar class weapons like shot guns simultaneously. 

To make every run more interesting we buffed all the card trophies.  

We'll post a bigger update about the progress we've made with the second mode very soon.


Stay tuned!

Flox team

notes.title: Progress Update #2
notes.content:
Those of you who've played the demo might have noticed another mode called the MAZE and this is what we've been working on for a while now. 


The MAZE is a mega structure that changes every time a mist hunters enters it. The goal is to get to the mysterious power source that holds the MAZE together and destroy it. But it won't be easy. Every time you die you'll be thrown back to the MAZE's doorstep. 


Drawing inspiration from games like Hexen, Heretic and Quake, we wanted our levels to have a similar labyrinth-like structure. So, we've started with a toolset that would allow us to create open semi-procedural levels with secrets, key locked doors and monster closets. 


This is how it works. We design a number of level chunks, place enemies, pick-ups and secrets in those chunks. Then we create templates, basically make a diagram of how those chunks should be put together.  Usually, in other games of this genre this step is giving out to the algorithms, but this approach gives less control over the flow of the level.  

There is just a handful of level chunks, so I just put them arbitrary together to show how a most primitive template is being made. 
https://i.imgur.com/zoLbAiP.gif


This is how it looks in the editor, when a level is being generated using the template.

https://i.imgur.com/7FduOEK.gif 

And how it looks in the game

https://imgur.com/VHJsPvH


This method takes more effort and manual work, but I think the end result is well worth it.

 
Along with the toolset, we're also working on the MAZE's first world and its boss. Yes, there are going to be bosses. 
And this the first one you'll have to face in the MAZE.

The Lord Gizzard - the king of void looters and Feru Mist junkies.

 https://i.imgur.com/QeX5OEQ.gif

I don't want to give away his attacks, I'll only say that he has more then one phase. 


Stay tuned for more news.


If you want to say Hi or get smaller but more frequent updates you can join our  [b][url=https://discord.gg/RFnEhAk]discord[/url] [/b]

notes.title: Mist Hunter demo is out!
notes.content:
Hey all,

We finally made it. The latest demo of Mist Hunter is on steam, what means it has leaderboards now. 

For those who aren't familiar with the game and the demo. The demo contains one level of an endless arena mode, which should give you the first impression of the game mechanics. 

Your main goal in this mode is to get the highest score by killing enemies and striking combos. You also have a timer that you must replenish or you'll die when it runs out. Right now there are only four weapons and about 80 trophies to upgrade the character.


However, the arena  isn't the main mode and at the moment we're working on the next mode - MAZE.


MAZE is going to be a rogue-lite dungeon crawler with bosses, secrets, key hunting, and many more upgrades and weapons. We plan to release it somewhere in August.


Until then we will be updating the demo and collecting your feedback. So if you have interesting ideas or suggestions feel free to them with us here on steam forums or in our [url=https://discord.gg/RFnEhAk]Discord [/url]


Cheers,


Flox team
